MANDARIN — MOCK EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does 我 (wǒ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. I, me
   B. Goodbye
   C. Teacher
   D. Hello

2. Which word is pronounced érzi? (1 mark)
   A. 是
   B. 这
   C. 儿子
   D. 女儿

3. Which two syllables blend to make 椅子? (1 mark)
   A. bīng and xiāng
   B. zhuō and zi
   C. yǐ and zi
   D. diàn and shì

4. Which Chinese word means "today"? (1 mark)
   A. 今天 jīntiān
   B. 明天 míngtiān
   C. 休息 xiūxi
   D. 清真寺 qīngzhēnsì

5. Which Chinese word means "gift"? (1 mark)
   A. 大家 dàjiā
   B. 切 qiē
   C. 我们 wǒmen
   D. 礼物 lǐwù

6. In 我的生日是三月五号, on which date is the birthday? (1 mark)
   A. 3 March
   B. 5 May
   C. 5 March
   D. 3 May

7. What does 祝你生日快乐 mean? (1 mark)
   A. See you tomorrow
   B. Thank you for the cake
   C. Where is your birthday
   D. Happy birthday to you

8. Which sentence means "I drink tea."? (1 mark)
   A. 我喝茶。
   B. 我早饭吃饼。
   C. 这是什么?
   D. 我喜欢喝茶。

9. What does 牛肉 (niúròu) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Water
   B. Flat bread
   C. Vegetables
   D. Beef

10. Which body word is a single character, one you can write with 3 strokes? (1 mark)
   A. 耳 ěr (ear)
   B. 目 mù (eye)
   C. 头 tóu (head)
   D. 口 kǒu (mouth)

11. Which body part helps you hear? (1 mark)
   A. 眼睛 yǎnjing
   B. 耳朵 ěrduo
   C. 手 shǒu
   D. 鼻子 bízi

12. What does 干旱 (gānhàn) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Drought
   B. Also
   C. It rains
   D. Weather

13. What does 沙发在门旁边 mean? (1 mark)
   A. The sofa is in the garden
   B. The sofa is under the door
   C. The sofa is beside the door
   D. The door is in the sofa

14. In the syllable mā, which part is the final? (1 mark)
   A. m
   B. ā only with a dot
   C. ma
   D. a

15. Which Chinese word means "classmates"? (1 mark)
   A. 你 nǐ
   B. 我 wǒ
   C. 叫 jiào
   D. 同学们 tóngxuémen

16. Which sentence means "Good morning!"? (1 mark)
   A. 我叫小明。
   B. 谢谢!
   C. 再见!
   D. 早上好!

17. What does 我爱你 wǒ ài nǐ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I love you
   B. I am you
   C. I like you
   D. I see you

18. Fill the blank: 厨房里有____。 (There is a fridge in the kitchen.) (1 mark)
   A. 沙发
   B. 床
   C. 电视
   D. 冰箱

19. What does 学校 (xuéxiào) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Mosque
   B. School
   C. To go
   D. Tomorrow

20. What does 清真寺 (qīngzhēnsì) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Church
   B. Week (short form)
   C. Today
   D. Mosque

21. In reading aloud, what is stress? (1 mark)
   A. Saying an important word a little stronger
   B. Reading without tones
   C. Reading in a whisper
   D. Stopping after every word

22. Read the pinyin: péngyou sòng wǒ lǐwù. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. When is your birthday?
   B. We sing.
   C. We cut the cake.
   D. My friend gives me a gift.

23. Which word is pronounced wǎnfàn? (1 mark)
   A. 香蕉
   B. 蔬菜
   C. 晚饭
   D. 咖啡

24. What does 我用耳朵听 mean? (1 mark)
   A. I use my mouth to speak
   B. I use my hands to write
   C. I use my ears to hear
   D. I use my eyes to see

25. What does decoding a word mean? (1 mark)
   A. Hiding it
   B. Drawing it
   C. Using letters and sounds to work out how to say it
   D. Copying it

26. Read the pinyin: wǒ jiā yǒu wǔ kǒu rén. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. There are five people in my family.
   B. That is my younger brother.
   C. This is my father.
   D. Who is this?

27. Which Chinese word means "school"? (1 mark)
   A. 清真寺 qīngzhēnsì
   B. 去 qù
   C. 昨天 zuótiān
   D. 学校 xuéxiào

28. What does 今天 (jīntiān) mean? (1 mark)
   A. School
   B. Today
   C. Mosque
   D. Tomorrow

29. What is a 田字格 used for? (1 mark)
   A. Cutting paper
   B. Writing characters neatly in a square with cross lines
   C. Drawing maps
   D. Counting money

30. Which sentence is written on a birthday card? (1 mark)
   A. 你好吗?
   B. 我叫小明。
   C. 再见!
   D. 祝你生日快乐!

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Explain why tones are important in Mandarin. Give one example with meanings. (3 marks)

32. Write in Chinese and pinyin: "Today it rains." (2 marks)

33. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: wǒ xǐhuan hē chá. (2 marks)

34. Explain how to pause when reading: what does a comma mean and what does a full stop mean? (3 marks)

35. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "My birthday is on 5 March." (3 marks)

36. Write two foods from each group: fruit and meat, with pinyin. (3 marks)

37. Give two reasons why it is important to place household items in their right places. (2 marks)

38. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 谢谢, 哭 and 星期三. (3 marks)

39. Write the Chinese for "I laugh" and "I cry" with pinyin. (2 marks)

40. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "For breakfast I eat bǐng." (2 marks)

41. Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The wind is very strong." and "Today it rains." (4 marks)

42. Write a five-sentence weather diary for one week in Chinese with pinyin. (5 marks)

43. Give two words with the final -ao and one with the final -ang, with pinyin. (3 marks)

44. Write in Chinese with pinyin: "The sofa is beside the door." (2 marks)

45. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: míngtiān shì xīngqīsì. (2 marks)

46. Write in Chinese and pinyin: "The wind is very strong." (2 marks)

47. Explain how nǐ hǎo is really said, and why. (2 marks)

48. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: wǒmen qiē dàngāo. (2 marks)

49. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "There are five people in my family." (3 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — MOCK EXAM #3 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — I, me
   我 (wǒ) means I, me.

2. C — 儿子
   儿子 is pronounced érzi and means son.

3. C — yǐ and zi
   yǐ + zi = yǐzi, chair.

4. A — 今天 jīntiān
   今天 (jīntiān) means today.

5. D — 礼物 lǐwù
   礼物 (lǐwù) means gift.

6. C — 5 March
   三月 is March and 五号 is the fifth.

7. D — Happy birthday to you
   祝 is to wish, and 生日快乐 is happy birthday.

8. A — 我喝茶。
   我喝茶。 (wǒ hē chá.) means "I drink tea.".

9. D — Beef
   牛肉 (niúròu) means beef.

10. D — 口 kǒu (mouth)
   口 has three strokes; 头 has 5, 耳 has 6 and 目 has 5.

11. B — 耳朵 ěrduo
   耳朵 are ears.

12. A — Drought
   干旱 (gānhàn) means drought.

13. C — The sofa is beside the door
   旁边 is beside.

14. D — a
   m is the initial and a is the final, with the first tone.

15. D — 同学们 tóngxuémen
   同学们 (tóngxuémen) means classmates.

16. D — 早上好!
   早上好! (zǎoshang hǎo!) means "Good morning!".

17. A — I love you
   爱 is love.

18. D — 冰箱
   The fridge is in the kitchen.

19. B — School
   学校 (xuéxiào) means school.

20. D — Mosque
   清真寺 (qīngzhēnsì) means mosque.

21. A — Saying an important word a little stronger
   Stress makes key words stand out but does not change the tone.

22. D — My friend gives me a gift.
   péngyou sòng wǒ lǐwù. is 朋友送我礼物。, which means "My friend gives me a gift.".

23. C — 晚饭
   晚饭 is pronounced wǎnfàn and means dinner.

24. C — I use my ears to hear
   耳朵 is ears and 听 is hear.

25. C — Using letters and sounds to work out how to say it
   Decoding uses letter-sound knowledge.

26. A — There are five people in my family.
   wǒ jiā yǒu wǔ kǒu rén. is 我家有五口人。, which means "There are five people in my family.".

27. D — 学校 xuéxiào
   学校 (xuéxiào) means school.

28. B — Today
   今天 (jīntiān) means today.

29. B — Writing characters neatly in a square with cross lines
   It keeps characters even and centred.

30. D — 祝你生日快乐!
   祝你生日快乐 is happy birthday to you.

SECTION B
----
31. (3 marks)
   Answer: The tone changes the meaning of a word. For example mā means mother but mǎ means horse.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for saying tone changes meaning, 2 marks for a correct pair with meanings.

32. (2 marks)
   Answer: 今天下雨。 jīntiān xià yǔ.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin.

33. (2 marks)
   Answer: I like to drink tea.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

34. (3 marks)
   Answer: A comma is a short pause and a full stop is a longer pause, so you can breathe and the listener can follow.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for comma, 1 mark for full stop, 1 mark for the reason.

35. (3 marks)
   Answer: 我的生日是三月五号。 wǒ de shēngrì shì sān yuè wǔ hào.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

36. (3 marks)
   Answer: Fruit: 芒果 mángguǒ, 香蕉 xiāngjiāo. Meat: 牛肉 niúròu, 鸡肉 jīròu.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for fruit, 1 mark for meat, 1 mark for correct pinyin.

37. (2 marks)
   Answer: It keeps the house tidy and safe, and it is easier to find things.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

38. (3 marks)
   Answer: 谢谢: xièxie, thank you. 哭: kū, to cry. 星期三: xīngqīsān, Wednesday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

39. (2 marks)
   Answer: 我笑 wǒ xiào; 我哭 wǒ kū.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

40. (2 marks)
   Answer: 我早饭吃饼。 wǒ zǎofàn chī bǐng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

41. (4 marks)
   Answer: 风很大。 fēng hěn dà. 今天下雨。 jīntiān xià yǔ.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

42. (5 marks)
   Answer: 星期一,太阳很大。星期二,有云。星期三,下雨。星期四,风很大。星期五,太阳很大。 xīngqīyī, tàiyáng hěn dà. xīngqī'èr, yǒu yún. xīngqīsān, xià yǔ. xīngqīsì, fēng hěn dà. xīngqīwǔ, tàiyáng hěn dà.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each day with weather and pinyin.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example 好 hǎo, 小 xiǎo; 房 fáng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: 沙发在门旁边。 shāfā zài mén pángbiān.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: Tomorrow is Thursday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: 风很大。 fēng hěn dà.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin.

47. (2 marks)
   Answer: It is said like ní hǎo, because when two third tones come together, the first changes to a second tone.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the changed sound and 1 mark for the rule.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: We cut the cake.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

49. (3 marks)
   Answer: 我家有五口人。 wǒ jiā yǒu wǔ kǒu rén.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.
